newsitem.title: INDIA: Cricket-Bad weather delays Australia's first match.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Bad weather delays Australia's first match.

text.p: A damp wicket and waterlogged outfield ruled out play in the first two sessions on the opening day of the Australian cricket team's first match on its Indian tour on Saturday.
The three-day match against an Indian selection is Australia's only match before a one-off Test match next week.
The pitch got damaged after a storm on Thursday blew away covers exposing it to heavy showers.
Umpires S.K. Porel and I. Sivaram inspected the ground in the morning and ruled out play until tea when another inspection of the pitch is due.
Bad weather has affected the Australian team's practice since their arrival in India four days ago.
Apart from the Test match, Australia will play a triangular limited overs series with India and South Africa during the month-long tour.
Australian skipper Mark Taylor, his deputy Ian Healy and Steve Waugh came to the ground to consult the umpires before they returned to the hotel.
